company.name: Holland & Barrett
company.distributes: Vitamins, health foods, free-from grocery, snacks and better-for-you confectionery.
company.channels_supplied: Own stores including Blackett Street in Newcastle city centre and online.
company.sf_brands_carried: Already lists Diablo products online and carries Free'ist no added sugar chocolate.
what_they_do_well: Launched 500 new grocery lines in its first wave of a food range overhaul, including 200 branded lines.
company.fit_rationale: The UK's main health food chain already lists Diablo, so the job is to widen the range and secure Newcastle store distribution. It carries the competitor Free'ist, and around 4 stores are listed in Northumberland plus a Newcastle city centre shop.
